title: ChemInform Abstract: Chemistry and Physics of the Novel Molecular‐Based Compound Exhibiting a Spontaneous Magnetization Below Tc = 14 K, MnCu(obbz)·1 H2O (obbz: Oxamidobis(benzoato)). Comparison with the Antiferromagnet MnCu(obbz)·5 H2O. Crystal Structure and Magnetic Properties of NiCu(obbz)·6 H2O.
abstract: AbstractThe title compound (I) and the MnCu complex containing 5 H2O are prepared via the dinatrium salt of oxamidobis(benzoato)cuprate (56% yield) by reaction with Ni or Mn perchlorate in H2O. Dehydration of the pentahydrate in vacuum or on heating at 65 °C gives the MnCu complex containing one mole H2O. (I) crystallizes in P21/n with Z=4.
